title: A Home Assistant climate entity: a thermostat, heat pump or air conditioner

alert.detail.description: An alert design's explanation and what to do; empty when nothing is wrong.

alert.help_url.description: Where an alert's Help goes: an HTTPS page the host chooses; empty for none.

alert.message.description: An alert design's headline (`Left open for 30 minutes`); empty when nothing is wrong.

card.title.description: The card's own `title:`, when it has one.

climate.s0.attributes.current_temperatur.description: The room temperature formatted with its unit (`19.5°C`), or `—` when it reports none: for a design that shows the reading as text.

climate.s0.attributes.hvac_action_label.description: What it is doing now, for display (`Heating`, `Idle`), else its mode.

climate.s0.attributes.temperature_label.description: The set point formatted with its unit and an arrow (`↑ 21°C`), or `—` when it has none.

climate.s0.current_humidity.description: The room humidity, 0 to 100; -9999 (HaLiveBindings.ABSENT) when the entity doesn't report it.

climate.s0.current_temperature.description: The room temperature it reads, in climate.s0.unit; -9999 (HaLiveBindings.ABSENT) when the entity doesn't report it.

climate.s0.fan_mode.description: The fan mode, for systems with a fan; empty for none.

climate.s0.hvac_action.description: What it is doing now, where it reports it: `heating`, `cooling`, `idle`, `drying`, `fan`, `off`; empty when it doesn't.

climate.s0.is_available.description: False while the entity is unavailable or missing.

climate.s0.is_on.description: Whether Home Assistant counts the state as on.

climate.s0.last_changed.description: When the state last changed, in whole Unix seconds; 0 when unknown.

climate.s0.last_changed_offset.description: The UTC offset in force at last_changed in the host's time zone, in seconds.

climate.s0.max_temp.description: The highest set point it accepts, in climate.s0.unit.

climate.s0.min_temp.description: The lowest set point it accepts, in climate.s0.unit.

climate.s0.name.description: The thermostat's name: the card's `name:`, else its friendly name.

climate.s0.picture.description: A picture of the device: a camera snapshot for a real-world design, else the entity's own picture, as `app:` or `https:` (PROTOCOL.md §6.1). Absent when the host has none; the design shows its own drawing.

climate.s0.preset.description: The active preset (`eco`, `away`, `boost`); empty for none.

climate.s0.state.description: Its state as Home Assistant formats it for display, in the person's language (`Closed`, `Heat`).

climate.s0.target_temp_high.description: A range thermostat's upper set point (heat_cool); -9999 (HaLiveBindings.ABSENT) when the entity doesn't report it.

climate.s0.target_temp_low.description: A range thermostat's lower set point (heat_cool); -9999 (HaLiveBindings.ABSENT) when the entity doesn't report it.

climate.s0.target_temp_step.description: The set point's step, in climate.s0.unit.

climate.s0.target_temperature.description: The set point, in climate.s0.unit (a thermostat that is off, or holds a range, reports none); -9999 (HaLiveBindings.ABSENT) when the entity doesn't report it.

climate.s0.unit.description: The temperature unit the values are in: `°C` or `°F`.

set_temperature.description: The person changed the set point: the host calls set_temperature.

set_temp_low.description: The person changed a range's lower set point.

set_temp_high.description: The person changed a range's upper set point.

set_hvac_mode.description: The person chose a mode: the host calls set_hvac_mode.

set_preset.description: The person chose a preset: the host calls set_preset_mode.

more_info.description: Open Home Assistant's more-info dialog for the entity.

help.description: Open alert.help_url, on hosts the app allowlists.

not-reaching.climate.s0.name: Hallway
not-reaching.alert.detail: Heating for 2 hours and the room is still 16 °C. Check the boiler pressure.
